name: mycs/proxmox
description: Reads a Proxmox VE cluster with an API token (nodes, guests, their MACs and IPs, RRD graphs), trying each node's address in turn; and the customers' console relay (noVNC), run next to the cluster with its own console-only token. Framework-free.

suggest.ext-curl: the console relay's requests to the cluster and to MyCS (bin/console-relay)
suggest.ext-pcntl: the console relay ends cleanly on SIGTERM
